text:
Site na 13 June ruo 11 July 1982, Spain kwadoro Iko Mba Ụwa nke iri na abụọ nke FIFA, nke mbụ ndị otu 24 so na ya mgbe e gbasaa ya site na 16, mgbasawanye nke meghere ohere ndị ọzọ maka ndị otu Africa na Asia. Ọnụọgụgụ ndị otu mere ka ọ bụrụ Iko Mba Ụwa kasịnụ ruo mgbe ahụ, na ngụkọta ndị bịara bụ 2,109,723 n’ime egwuregwu 52, ihe dị ka 40,572 kwa egwuregwu. Usoro ahụ jikọtara agba mbụ nke otu isii nwere otu anọ, ebe ndị abụọ kacha elu na-aga n’ihu, ya na agba otu nke abụọ pụrụ iche nke otu anọ nwere otu atọ; ndị mmeri otu anọ ruru ọkara ikpeazụ, wee soro ikpeazụ na egwuregwu nke atọ.

Ụzọ gaa n’ọla mmeri bụ nke Italy, bụ ndị si n’agba otu mbụ pụta na-enweghị mmeri ọ bụla, ha kpara nkata atọ ma na-aga n’ihu site n’ihe mgbaru ha nwetara. Ntụgharị bịara n’agba nke abụọ, ebe Paolo Rossi onye na-enwetụbeghị goolu tupu mgbe ahụ gbara okpu atọ iji chụpụ ndị Brazil bụ ndị a na-atụ anya ha. Rossi gara n’ihu bụrụ onye kacha nweta goolu isii, nweta Golden Ball nke mbụ dị ka onye ọkpụkpọ kacha mma n’asọmpi ahụ, ma bụrụ onye pụrụ iche nwetara Iko Mba Ụwa, aha onye kacha nweta goolu na Golden Ball n’otu mbipụta. Mgbe ọ dị afọ 40, onye isi otu Italy na onye nche goolu Dino Zoff ghọrọ onye ọkpụkpọ kacha okenye meriri Iko Mba Ụwa.

N’ikpeazụ n’ama egwuregwu Santiago Bernabeu dị na Madrid, Italy meriri West Germany 3-1 n’oge zuru oke, na-enweghị oge mgbakwunye. Rossi meghere goolu na nkeji 57, Marco Tardelli tinye nke abụọ na nkeji 69 na Alessandro Altobelli tinye nke atọ na nkeji 81, tupu Paul Breitner weghachi otu maka West Germany na nkeji 83. Ọ bụ aha mmeri nke atọ nke Italy; West Germany bịara nke abụọ ma Poland were nke atọ.

Asọmpi ahụ wepụtara akụkọ na-adịgide. Egwuregwu ọkara ikpeazụ nke West Germany na France kwụsịrị 3-3 mgbe oge mgbakwunye gasịrị ma kpebie ya site na penariti mbụ n’akụkọ Iko Mba Ụwa, nke West Germany meriri 5-4; a na-echetakwa egwuregwu ahụ maka mgbakasị ike nke Harald Schumacher na Patrick Battiston, nke e nyeghị mmejọ. ‘Disgrace of Gijon’, mmeri 1-0 nke West Germany meriri Austria nke wepụrụ Algeria, mechara mee ka FIFA hazie egwuregwu otu ikpeazụ n’otu oge. Mmeri 10-1 nke Hungary meriri El Salvador ka bụ ihe kacha ibu n’akụkọ Iko Mba Ụwa.
